verdict.rationale: PagerDuty is a SaaS platform with a REST API and an official MCP server, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only mentions that an authentication token exists and that the MCP server lets assistants interact "securely". Nothing in the pack documents scoped, read-only, least-privilege or per-agent credentials, OAuth scopes, or token permission controls.
